blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language-action policies control embodied agents through a perception-action loop grounded in physical interaction, where adversarial patches can corrupt action predictions and thereby alter subsequent observations. To mitigate these threats, many existing defenses rely on policy adaptation or auxiliary models, but require additional training or inference. We introduce RECLAIM, a training-free, inference-time defense that uses a frozen VLA's own attention response to local visual interventions to guide purification during closed-loop embodied manipulation. Our key insight is that attention changes induced by local edits provide feedback for choosing where and how to purify as the robot interacts with its environment. RECLAIM combines this feedback with robot geometry to refine patch localization and select local treatments, then revalidates them as the agent's embodied actions change the observed scene. We evaluate RECLAIM against patches generated by four adversarial attack methods across multiple manipulation task suites under frozen VLA control. Under adversarial patch attacks, RECLAIM succeeds in at least one rollout on 95% of the evaluated tasks and raises rollout success on LIBERO-Object from 0% without defense to 70.0%. Its mean decision time is only 548.9 ms per control step. These results highlight policy-guided visual purification as an effective approach to defending embodied agents against adversarial patches and recovering closed-loop task execution.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言-行动政策控制通过一种基于物理互动的认知-行动循环来体现代理人,在这种循环中,对抗性补丁可以破坏行动预测,从而改变随后的观察。 为了减轻这些威胁,许多现有的防御依靠政策调整或辅助模式,但需要额外的培训或推论. 我们引入了RECLAIM,一种无训练的,推论的防御,它使用VLA自己对局部视觉干预的注意反应,指导闭路内装操纵时的净化. 我们的关键见解是,由本地编辑引发的注意力变化,为选择机器人与其环境相互作用的地方和方式提供反馈。 RECLAIM将这种反馈与机器人几何结合,以完善补丁本地化并选择局部治疗方法,然后随着代理器的内含动作改变被观测到的场景而重新验证. 我们对照四种对抗性攻击方法产生的补丁来评价RECLAIM,这些补丁跨越了被冻结的VLA控制下的多个操纵任务套件. 在对抗性补丁攻击下,RECLAIM在95%的评估任务上至少成功推出一次,并将LIBERO-Object的推出成功率从没有防御的0%提高到70.0%. 其平均决定时间仅为每个控制步骤548.9毫秒. 这些成果突出表明,以政策指导的视觉净化是有效方法,用以保护有形代理人免受对抗性补丁的伤害,并恢复封闭式脱落任务的执行。

blocks.en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models use visual observations and language instructions to predict robot actions [ 25 , 11 ] . Their visual representations determine the scene information available for action prediction, so corrupted perception can change how the robot interacts with its surroundings. The security of embodied deployment therefore depends on the integrity of visual perception. Adversarial patches introduce localized patterns to redirect visual predictions [ 2 ] . In VLA control, they exploit this dependence by altering the camera observation: the altered pixels change the encoded visual features and can redirect action predictions without changing policy parameters [ 21 , 22 ] . The resulting interference can propagate through the perception–action loop. An erroneous movement changes the robot and object state, altering the next observation and potentially compounding the initial disturbance. Protecting VLA deployment thus requires recovering instruction-following control as interaction continues.
blocks.zh: Vision-language-Action(VLA)模型使用视觉观测和语言指示来预测机器人动作[25,11]. 他们的视觉表现决定了可用于动作预测的场景信息,因此被腐蚀的感知可以改变机器人与其周围环境的相互作用. 因此,具体部署的安全取决于视觉感觉的完整性。 逆向补丁引入了局部规律来重定向视觉预测[2]. 在VLA控制中,他们通过改变相机观察来利用这种依赖性:被改变的像素会改变被编码的视觉特征,并且可以在不改变政策参数的情况下重定向动作预测[21,22]. 由此产生的干扰可以通过感知-行动循环传播。 错误的移动会改变机器人和物体状态,改变下个观测,并可能使初始扰动复杂化. 因此,保护志愿军的部署需要随着互动的继续而恢复遵循指示的控制。

blocks.en: Existing defenses address this vulnerability through auxiliary perception or adversarial training, introducing additional deployment requirements [ 8 , 22 ] . PAD refines patch localization with pretrained segmentation [ 8 ] , adding model inference to input processing. Xu et al. fine-tune the visual encoder to align clean and adversarial representations [ 22 ] , requiring perturbed training samples and parameter updates before deployment. Run-time intervention avoids updating the controlled policy but can retain external dependencies: BYOVLA identifies task-irrelevant regions through external scene interpretation and probes policy sensitivity before editing them [ 5 ] . Its scene interpretation adds auxiliary inference to the intervention process. These requirements increase online computation or offline adaptation work, complicating deployment when resources or opportunities for retraining are limited. Reducing these dependencies calls for a defense that guides localization and treatment selection using the VLA’s available responses.
blocks.zh: 现有防御工事通过辅助感知或对抗性训练来解决这种脆弱性,引入了额外的部署要求[8,22]. PAD用预先训练分解来精炼补丁本地化[8],为输入处理添加模型推论. 徐等对视觉编码器进行微调,以配合干净和相对抗的表述[22],在部署前需要扰动的训练样本和参数更新. 运行时间干预避免更新被控制的政策,但可以保留外部依赖性: BYOVLA通过外部场景解读确定与任务相关的区域,并在编辑前探究其政策敏感性[5]. 它的场景解读为干预过程增加了辅助推论. 这些要求增加了在线计算或离线适应工作,使资源或再培训机会有限时部署工作复杂化。 减少这些依赖性需要一种防御,利用VLA的现有反应来指导本地化和治疗选择.

blocks.en: This requirement raises a spatial challenge of distinguishing suspicious attention from legitimate manipulation responses, and a temporal challenge of maintaining suitable interventions as the scene changes. Analyses of VLA visual attention show that patches can attract responses away from the arm and relevant objects [ 22 ] . Yet the gripper and manipulated object also attract attention, making response strength alone ambiguous. To interpret the robot-related part of this response, known robot geometry can account for attention associated with the arm and gripper, leaving residual concentrations for inspection. For each proposed region, the defense must then determine the most suitable treatment while retaining visual evidence needed for manipulation. As motion changes the robot–object relationship, earlier choices require renewed assessment so that useful treatments remain available and unsuitable ones can be replaced. Sustained recovery therefore depends on spatial interpretation, treatment selection, and temporal updating.
blocks.zh: 这一要求提出了区分可疑注意力与合法操纵反应的空间挑战,以及随着场景变化而保持适当干预的时间挑战。 对VLA视觉关注的分析显示,补丁可以吸引远离手臂和相关物体的反应 [22]. 然而,控制器和被操纵的物体也引起人们的注意,使单是反应力量就变得模糊不清。 为了解释这个响应中与机器人相关的部分,已知的机器人几何可以算出与手臂和抓取器相关的注意力,留下了残留浓度以供检查. 对于每一个拟议区域,辩护方必须确定最适当的待遇,同时保留为操纵所需的视觉证据. 随着运动改变机器人-对象关系,早期的选择需要重新评估,以便保留有用的治疗方法,并可以替换不合适的方法。 因此,持续恢复取决于空间解释、治疗选择和时间更新。

blocks.en: Our key insight is that the defended VLA can assess local interventions through changes in its own attention and action predictions. Comparing alternative views of the same observation with the same frozen policy makes these responses comparable in the current task context, even when a corresponding clean observation is unavailable. Repeating this assessment as interaction progresses connects purification to the policy’s changing perception and action.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要见解是,被保护的志愿军可以通过改变自己的注意力和行动预测来评估当地干预措施。 将同一意见的替代观点与同一被冻结的政策进行比较,使得这些答复在目前的任务背景下具有可比性,即使没有相应的清洁观察。 随着互动的进展,重复这一评估将净化与政策不断变化的观念和行动联系起来。

blocks.en: Figure 1 introduces RECLAIM, which couples three components for inference-time protection of the perception–action loop. Geometry-Guided Attention Localization (GAL) combines persistent attention with projected arm and gripper geometry to expose suspicious residual concentrations. Attention-Response-Guided Purification (ARP) compares local treatments through attention redistribution and action uncertainty. Memory-Assisted Temporal Revalidation (MTR) retains earlier treatments for comparison with fresh proposals and reassesses their suitability as the scene changes. The selected treatment modifies the observation supplied to the same frozen VLA for action generation.
blocks.zh: 图1介绍了RECLAIM, 夫妇对感知-行动循环的推断-时间保护有三个组成部分。 几何-指向注意局部化(GAL)结合了持续的注意与预测臂和抓取几何来暴露出可疑的残留浓度. 注意-反应-指导净化(ARP)通过注意力再分配和行动不确定性比较当地治疗. 记忆辅助性临时调整(MTR)保留了早期的治疗方法,以便与新建议进行比较,并随着场景的变化重新评估其适宜性. 选择的治疗方法修改了提供给同一被冻结的VLA用于行动生成的观察.

blocks.en: We evaluate RECLAIM on frozen OpenVLA across 40 tasks in four LIBERO suites [ 14 ] and four patch attacks [ 21 , 22 , 15 ] . Under matched UADA conditions, RECLAIM raises rollout success from 0.0% without defense to 52.92%, versus accelerated PAD’s 40.83%. It also improves mask alignment and uses 77.31% less mean decision time than accelerated PAD. With unchanged defense settings, success ranges from 38.33% to 54.58% across the four attacks. Ablations support the contributions of response-guided treatment selection and temporal revalidation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价冷冻的OpenVLA 在四个LIBERO套房的40个任务 和四个补丁攻击[21,22,15]。 在与非洲农业联盟相匹配的条件下,RECLAIM将推出成功率从没有防御的0.0 %提高到52.92%,而加速的PAD为40.83%. 它还改进了口罩对接,使用的平均决策时间比加速的PAD少77.31%. 由于防御设置不变,成功率从38.33%到54.58%不等。 减值支持反应指导治疗选择和时间再验证的贡献.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows. • We formulate input-side defense for a frozen VLA as stateful local visual intervention, using the policy’s attention and action responses to guide recovery of instruction-following control. • We develop RECLAIM, coupling geometry-guided localization, response-guided purification, and memory-assisted temporal revalidation to counter patch interference and sustain instruction-following control as embodied interaction changes the scene. • We demonstrate task recovery across four patch attacks, quantify intervention alignment and decision cost, and examine component contributions through ablations.
blocks.zh: - 我们的捐款如下。 我们为冻结的VLA制定投入-侧防作为状态上的地方视觉干预,利用政策的注意力和行动反应来指导恢复遵循指令的控制。 我们开发了RECLAIM,结合了几何制导本地化,反应制导净化,以及内存辅助时间再验证,以对抗补丁干扰并维持所体现指令跟随控制会改变场景. ^ 我们通过四起补丁攻击来显示任务恢复,量化干预调整和决策成本,并通过模拟检查各组成部分的贡献。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Wang et al. [ 21 ] expose the vulnerability of VLA-controlled manipulation to localized visual patches. Their Untargeted Action Discrepancy Attack (UADA) maximizes action deviations, while UPA disrupts movement directions and TMA induces targeted manipulation errors. UADA reaches a maximum average task failure rate of 100 % 100\% in their simulation experiments and an attack success rate exceeding 43 % 43\% in real-world trials. The resulting erratic movements show how image corruption can propagate into physical execution, threatening both task completion and safe interaction. These risks underscore the importance of defending the perception–action loop for reliable embodied deployment. This attack framework underlies our primary evaluation. Complementing these attacks on action outputs, Xu et al. introduce the Embedding Disruption Patch Attack (EDPA), which generates patches by disrupting visual–textual alignment and separating perturbed visual representations from clean ones [ 22 ] . They counter this representation-level interference by adversarially fine-tuning the visual encoder, requiring clean–perturbed training pairs and parameter updates. Lu et al. develop UPA-RFAS, combining feature disruption, attention dominance, and image–text misalignment to improve universal patch transfer [ 15 ] . We denote this attack as RFAS to distinguish it from Wang et al.’s UPA [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 王等编. [21] 暴露出VLA所控制的操纵对局部视觉补丁的脆弱性. 它们的无目标行动失常攻击(UADA)会使动作偏差最大化,而UPA会干扰运动方向,TMA会诱发有目标的操纵错误. UADA在模拟实验中达到最高平均任务失败率为100%-100%-%,在现实世界试验中攻击成功率超过43%-%. 由此而来的变化无常表明,图像腐败如何会传播到实际执行中,威胁到任务的完成和安全的互动。 这些风险突出表明,必须维护可靠部署的概念-行动循环。 这个攻击框架是我们初步评估的基础。 为了补充这些对动作输出的攻击,徐等人提出了嵌入干扰补丁攻击(EPA),它通过干扰视觉-文字对接和将扰动的视觉表现与干净的视觉表现相分离来产生补丁[22]. 他们通过对抗性地微调视觉编码器来抵消这种表现层面的干扰,这需要干净-扰动的训练对和参数更新. blocks.en: Patch purification methods locate and remove corrupted image content before prediction. PAD uses semantic independence and spatial heterogeneity for localization, followed by pretrained segmentation to refine removal masks [ 8 ] . DIFFender couples localization and restoration through text-guided diffusion with few-shot prompt tuning [ 9 ] , while APEX combines region extraction, blur and boundary cues, and structure-guided inpainting [ 20 ] . These methods evaluate purification through visual recognition performance and patch-localization quality. Such criteria do not determine whether a treatment preserves the visual cues needed for a robot’s next action or remains appropriate as manipulation changes the scene. Their auxiliary processing also introduces deployment dependencies: PAD invokes a segmentation model, while DIFFender requires diffusion inference and prompt adaptation. Building on local patch purification, RECLAIM addresses these control and deployment requirements by using the defended VLA itself to assess treatments in the current task context, without auxiliary perception or a separately trained defense model.
blocks.zh: 补丁净化方法在预测前定位并去除已损坏的图像内容. PAD使用语义独立和空间异质来进行局部化,后被先行分解来精炼去除口罩 [8]. DIFFER夫妇通过文字引导传播进行本地化和恢复,并用几发即时调用[9];而APEX则结合了区域取出,模糊和边界提示,以及结构引导的涂入[20]. 这些方法通过视觉识别性能和补丁本地化质量来评价净化. 此类标准无法确定治疗是否保留机器人下一步行动所需的视觉提示,或是否在操纵改变场景时仍然适当。 其辅助处理还引入了部署依赖性: PAD引用分化模型,而DIFFENDER则需要扩散推论和即时适应. 在局部补丁净化的基础上,RECLAIM通过使用被防守的VLA本身来评估当前任务背景下的治疗方法来解决这些控制和部署需要,没有辅助感知或单独训练的防御模型.

blocks.en: BYOVLA uses action sensitivity to guide observation editing without policy fine-tuning [ 5 ] . External VLM and segmentation models identify task-irrelevant regions; regional perturbations measure their influence on predicted actions and guide inpainting or background recoloring. RECLAIM adopts the principle of consulting the controlled policy, but extends the feedback beyond action sensitivity. Sensitivity to a region does not alone establish which purification to prefer. RECLAIM compares treatments through regional attention reduction and action uncertainty, requiring cross-operator attention agreement outside the edited region. It therefore assesses both suppression within the candidate region and consistency over the remaining scene, enabling purification selection without first assigning the suspected patch an external task-irrelevance label.
blocks.zh: BYOVLA使用动作敏感来指导观察编辑,而无需政策微调[5]. 外部VLM和分块模型确定与任务无关的区域;区域扰动测量其对所预测行动的影响并指导涂料或背景再涂色. RECLAM采纳了咨询受控政策的原则,但将反馈扩展到行动敏感性之外. 对一个区域的敏感性并不单是确定哪个净化更可取。 RECLAIM通过减少区域注意力和行动不确定性来比较治疗,需要编辑区域以外的跨操作者关注协议. 因此,它既评估了候选区域内的压制情况,又评估了其余场景的一致性,从而能够进行净化选择,而不首先给被怀疑的补丁打上与任务无关的外部标签。

blocks.en: Attention studies provide evidence that frozen vision-language models retain spatial information useful beyond image-level prediction. Kang et al. [ 10 ] identify a small set of heads whose responses localize text-referred objects. ResCLIP finds that intermediate-layer query–key attention captures spatial correspondences between image regions; incorporating these responses into the final layer improves localization for dense visual prediction [ 23 ] . Together, these findings support using native attention as a source of spatial cues for localization. In manipulation, strong responses can also arise from the arm, gripper, and task objects. Wang et al. [ 21 ] suggest robot-joint relationships as a potential defense cue. Robot geometry can therefore help interpret attended regions, while comparing attention before and after local edits provides feedback about their effect on the policy’s visual processing. These complementary insights motivate grounding patch purification in embodied policy feedback, connecting spatial localization and treatment selection to continued task execution.
blocks.zh: 注意研究提供证据表明被冻结的视觉语言模型保留了超出图像水平预测的空间信息. 姜等编. [10] 确定一组小标题,其答复将文本上提及的对象本地化。 ResCLIP发现中间层查询-键注意会捕捉到图像区域之间的空间相通;将这些反应纳入到最后层会改善密度视觉预测的本地化[23]. 这些研究结果共同支持将本地关注作为本地化空间提示的来源。 在操纵中,手臂,钳子和任务对象也可能产生强烈的反应. 王等编. [21]建议机器人-联合关系作为潜在的防御提示. 因此,机器人几何可以帮助解释所覆盖的区域,同时比较当地编辑前后的注意力,提供它们对政策视觉处理效果的反馈. 这些互补的见解促使人们将补丁净化作为体现的政策反馈的基础,将空间定位和治疗选择与继续执行任务联系起来。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : RECLAIM framework. GAL combines persistent attention with projected robot occupancy to propose regions. ARP evaluates fresh edits and recalled pairs on the current image, requiring cross-family support and ranking eligible treatments by attention reduction and bounded entropy gain. Protected selection yields a local edit or PASS \mathrm{PASS} for action generation by the frozen VLA. MTR stores selected pairs, recalls them at full decisions, and checks geometry and action validity between decisions.

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的提出

blocks.en: For deployment on unfamiliar patches and changing tasks, RECLAIM operates without patch masks, paired clean images, or clean reference actions. It uses attention and action-token probabilities from a frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policy π θ \pi_{\theta} to select visual interventions. At step t t , it receives a potentially patch-corrupted RGB image I t ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 I_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3} , instruction ℓ \ell , robot joint configuration q t q_{t} , and trusted parameters κ \kappa specifying robot geometry and camera projection. Normal images supply calibration scales before deployment.
blocks.zh: 为了在不熟悉的补丁上部署和改变任务,RECLAIM操作时没有补丁口罩,配对干净的图像,或干净的参考动作. 它利用被冻结的视觉-语言-行动(VLA)政策中的注意力和行动概率来选择视觉干预。 在步骤 t t 中, 它接收到一个可能修补的 RGB 图像 I t QQ R H × W×3 I_{t}\in\mathb{R}^{H\times W\times 3},指令l\ell,机器人联合配置 q t q_{t},并可信任参数 ^\ kappa 指定机器人几何和相机投影. 正常图像在部署前提供校准尺度.

blocks.en: 3.2 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.2 概览

blocks.en: RECLAIM links three components through attention-guided intervention (Fig. 2 ). Geometry-Guided Attention Localization (GAL) combines persistent attention with robot geometry to propose regions for inspection. Attention-Response-Guided Purification (ARP) tests local edits and uses attention redistribution and action uncertainty to select purification. Memory-Assisted Temporal Revalidation (MTR) reevaluates selected region–operator pairs as manipulation changes the scene, allowing useful earlier alternatives to compete with new proposals.
blocks.zh: RECLAM通过受关注指导的干预将三个组成部分联系起来(图2)。 几何-指向注意局部化(GAL)将持续关注与机器人几何结合,提出区域检查. 注意-响应-指向净化(ARP)测试本地编辑,并使用注意再分配和行动不确定性来选择净化. 随着操控的改变,记忆加速了时间调整(MTR)重新评价了选定的区域-操作者对子,从而允许早期有用的替代品与新提案相竞争。

blocks.en: We evaluate frozen OpenVLA policies [ 11 ] on the four LIBERO suites [ 14 ] , covering ten tasks per suite to test defense across scene layouts, object interactions, goals, and long-horizon manipulation. Different fixed initial states per task and three patch placements per state vary the starting configuration and spatial interference while preserving matched conditions across methods. This gives 80 clean rollouts and 240 rollouts per patch condition. OpenVLA fuses DINOv2 [ 17 ] and SigLIP [ 24 ] visual features [ 11 ] ; their pretrained weights remain frozen during defense. Control horizons are 220, 280, 300, and 520 steps for Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long, with early termination on success.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了被冻结的OpenVLA政策 [11] 在四个LIBERO套房[14], 涵盖每个套房的10个任务,测试防御跨场面布局,物体相互作用,目标,以及长视距操纵. 每个任务不同的固定初始状态和每个状态的3个补丁布置会改变起始配置和空间干扰,同时保留不同方法相匹配的条件. 这使得每个补丁条件有80个干净的推出和240个推出. OpenVLA引信为DINOv2 [17]和SigLIP [24] 视觉特性 [11];其预受训练的重量在防御期间仍然被冻结. 控制地平线为220道,280道,300道和520道,分别为"空间","物体","目标"和"长"等步道,成功后提前终止.

blocks.en: To vary spatial interference under these matched task conditions, we follow UADA’s initial-visibility placement principle [ 21 ] . Seeded sampling (20261116) distributes 50 × 50 50\times 50 patch footprints across spatially separated admissible background regions, relocating infeasible slots under the initial-view constraints. Positions are frozen before evaluation and remain fixed in image coordinates.

blocks.en: 4.2 RQ1: Recovery of Task Execution
blocks.zh: 4.2 RQ1: 恢复任务执行

blocks.en: RECLAIM raises SR from 0.00% to 52.92%, exceeding accelerated PAD by 12.08 pp and achieving higher SR in every suite. Task coverage improves from PAD’s 80.00% to 95.00% . RECLAIM’s 76.97% ARR exceeds PAD’s 59.39%, recovering a larger share of the attack-induced performance gap. Its executed masks achieve higher IoU (50.83% versus 37.69%) while modifying less of the image (6.87% versus 10.96%), indicating more concentrated interventions along the respective trajectories. RECLAIM also exceeds APEX by 28.33 pp on Object (70.00% versus 41.67%) and 11.67 pp on Goal (65.00% versus 53.33%). Together, these comparisons support the advantage of policy-guided intervention over conventional patch purification for robotic task recovery.
blocks.zh: RECLAIM将SR从0.0%提升到52.92%,超过12.08页加速的PAD,并在每套套房实现更高的SR. 任务覆盖率从PAD的80.0%提高到95.00 % 。 RECLAM的76.97%ARR超过了PAD的59.39 % , 在攻击引发的性能差距中恢复了更大的份额。 其被执行的口罩实现了更高的IoU(50.83%对37.69%),而修改的图像较少(6.87%对10.96%),表明各自轨迹的干预更加集中. RECLAIM还超过APEX的28.33页关于对象(70.0%对41.67%)和11.67页关于目标(65.00 %对53.33%)。 这些比较加在一起支持了政策指导干预相对于常规补丁净化对于机器人任务回收的优势.

blocks.en: The Grey-only control reaches 37.50% SR and 85.00% task coverage, showing the additional recovery obtained by combining localization with treatment selection and temporal revalidation. Telea-only reaches 47.92% SR and 92.50% task coverage. Even this effective single-operator treatment leaves a 5.00 pp SR gap to full RECLAIM. Selecting among alternative operators allows ARP to address conditions that committing to Telea alone does not resolve.
blocks.zh: 纯灰控制达到37.50%的SR和85.00 %的任务覆盖率,显示了通过将本地化与治疗选择和时间再验证相结合而获得的额外恢复. 只有Telea系统达到47.92%的SR和92.50%的任务覆盖率. 即使这种有效的单人操作治疗也留下了5.00ppSR的空白来达到完整的RECLAM. 在替代运营商中进行选择,使退休协会能够解决仅仅承诺Telia不能解决的条件。

blocks.en: Across Spatial, Object, and Goal, clean SR increases from 75.00% to 80.00%, while shuffle and grey decrease by 2.78 and 3.33 pp. RECLAIM therefore preserves aggregate clean task execution on these suites, with smaller changes under non-optimized perturbations. Long contributes most of the overall decrease: clean SR changes from 50.00% to 30.00%, and shuffle and grey each decrease by 25.00 pp. Across all four suites, clean task coverage remains 85.00%, with overall SR changes of − 1.25 -1.25 , − 8.33 -8.33 , and − 8.75 -8.75 pp for clean, shuffle, and grey. The principal intervention cost is concentrated in Long; aggregate clean execution is preserved in the other three suites. Long’s lower clean SR suggests greater baseline difficulty; its longer action sequences may also amplify small perception or purification errors, making accurate intervention harder to sustain throughout execution.

blocks.en: With the same defense configuration, RECLAIM reaches 53.75% SR under EDPA [ 22 ] , 54.58% under RFAS [ 15 ] , and 38.33% under UPA [ 21 ] , as summarized in Table 5 (a). The gains over the corresponding undefended policies are 50.42, 54.58, and 29.58 pp, with ARR values of 77.07%, 79.39%, and 49.31%. Long is already harder in the clean setting, with 50.00% SR versus 75.00% across the other three suites. Patches further reduce undefended Long SR to 0.00–3.33%; RECLAIM restores it to 25.00–43.33%. Across Spatial, Object, and Goal, defended SR reaches 57.78% for UADA, 57.22% for EDPA, 58.33% for RFAS, and 42.78% for UPA. Recovery thus extends across all four attacks in both the complete benchmark and the explicitly separated three-suite subset. Each comparison uses matched initial conditions and pre-generated patches.

blocks.en: We evaluate NORA [ 7 ] under the same UADA attack setting as OpenVLA, retaining native decoding, normalization, and policy-specific calibration (Table 5 (b)). RECLAIM achieves 53.49% SR on S/O/G and 40.12% across all four suites. NORA’s clean Long SR is only 5.00%, versus 80.00% on S/O/G; the latter therefore provides a more informative assessment of defense performance within the policy’s task capability. Together with the OpenVLA results, these findings support RECLAIM’s ability to protect different VLA models.
blocks.zh: 在与OpenVLA相同的UADA攻击设定下,我们评价NORA[7],保留本土编解码、正常化和政策特定校准(表5(b))。 RECLAM在S/O/G上实现了53.49%的SR,在所有四个套房中实现了40.12%. NORA的清洁长SR只有5.00 %,对S/O/G来说是80.00 %;因此,后者对政策任务能力范围内的国防表现提供了更加翔实的评估. 这些发现与OpenVLA结果一起,支持RECLAIM保护不同VLA模型的能力.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Generalist policies increasingly span diverse tasks and embodiments [ 16 , 4 , 1 ] , making reliable visual feedback important for sustained task execution.
blocks.zh: 一般性政策日益跨越各种不同的任务和表现[16、4、1],使可靠的视觉反馈对持续执行任务至关重要。

blocks.en: We presented RECLAIM, a training-free defense that uses a frozen VLA’s attention and action responses to guide local visual interventions. Robot geometry contextualizes attention, while treatment comparisons and temporal revalidation support continued task execution. On four LIBERO suites, RECLAIM recovers OpenVLA performance across four patch attacks and outperforms accelerated PAD under UADA in both success rate and mean decision cost. The accompanying improvement in mask alignment indicates more accurate placement of visual interventions along the evaluated trajectories. These findings highlight how embodied attention feedback can guide visual purification as robot actions change subsequent observations, connecting adversarial patch defense to continued task execution within the perception–action loop. This motivates further study of policy feedback for robust embodied control.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了RECLAIM, 这是一种免费训练的防御, 机器人几何学将注意力背景化,而治疗比较和时间再验证则支持任务继续执行. 在4个LIBERO套房上,RECLAIM恢复了OpenVLA在4个补丁攻击中的性能,并在UADA下加速了PAD的成功率和平均决策成本. 相伴而来的口罩对接的改进表明,视觉干预在评估的轨迹上的位置更为准确。 这些发现凸显出在机器人动作改变后续观察时, 如何引导视觉净化, 将对抗补丁防御与感知-行动圈内的任务持续执行联系起来。 这促使人们进一步研究政策反馈,以进行有力的综合控制。
